desc: Implement iterative bottom-up DP with collapsed states closed/open(residue)/invalid for all nodes; output Yes iff root is closed.
Define and enforce transition rules at each node for 0, 1, or 2+ open child fragments, including K=1, leaves, N=1, and high-degree vertices.
Validate the implementation against sample inputs 1 and 2 (both PASS) and verify correctness by hand-tracing small trees (paths, stars, multi-branch trees) for K=2,3,4.
Confirm no fallback needed: unique forced fragment length (s mod K) plus degree bound (ac<=2 closed, ac<=1 open) fully characterizes feasibility.
